title: Some iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max units have a weird new problem
description: Apple launched the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max this month, running iOS 27. The company recently pushed iOS 27.0.1 to fix a bug that caused the phones to restart when Face ID authentication failed. According to an increasing number of reports, that update didn't fix another issue people are encountering on the newest iPhones. title: Galaxy S27 Ultra said to be heavier than Galaxy S26 Ultra
description: There have been plenty of leaks and rumors surrounding Samsung’s upcoming flagship, the Galaxy S27 Ultra, which is expected to launch early next year. A new rumor has now revealed the phone’s alleged dimensions. While leaked CAD renders of the Galaxy S27 Ultra suggested that the phone would measure 7.97mm in thickness, a new rumor from tipster Ice Universe has now corroborated the figure. Alleged Galaxy S27 Ultra render According to the tipster, Samsung’s upcoming Ultra flagship will measure 7.9mm in thickness, matching the Galaxy S26 Ultra. The tipster also claims that the...

title: This is when Apple is rumored to be launching the HomePad
description: Apple's very long-rumored "HomePod with a screen", sometimes referred to as the HomePad, is now said to be finally launching on October 13, according to a new report from Bloomberg's Mark Gurman. This "smart-home hub code-named J490" is allegedly "at the center" of the company's strategy for the smart home. At the same time, Apple will also be launching an updated HomePod mini, as well as a new Apple TV 4K box. Both of those are a very long time coming - the former's predecessor dates from 2020, while the latter's is from 2022. Concept renders, not leaked images All three new...

title: AT&T is buying $3 billion worth of fibre optic cables from Corning
description: Today, AT&T has signed a new multi-year deal with Corning to purchase fibre optic cables. The deal is valued at more than $3 billion, and will help AT&T reach its stated goal of connecting 60 million homes and businesses with fibre optic cables by 2030. The carrier has already reached 30 million locations, so half of that, in June this year, six months ahead of its initial schedule. In its most recent results, those for the second quarter of this year, AT&T reported that it added 646,000 total consumer and business internet net subscribers, of which 367,000 were fibre optic internet...

title: Samsung Galaxy A18 4G review
Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra in for review
description: The line between tablets and laptops has been increasingly more blurred for the past few years. That's especially true for devices like the Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra - a top-of-the-line slate with a huge AMOLED display and a thin profile. It goes the other way as well; laptops nowadays get the same mobile-based chipsets and tablet-like battery life and fluidity. Perhaps the two categories were always destined to meet in the middle. This is the Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra, and it's a $1,399 (€1,569/£1,399) flagship with a close-to-15-inch 120Hz AMOLED display, an 11,600mAh battery, and a...

title: Amazon unveils faster Fire TV Stick 4K (2026) and a new Fire TV Remote
description: Amazon just unveiled a slimmer and faster Fire TV Stick 4K (2026) and a new Fire TV Remote. The stick is 20%-40% faster than similarly priced 4K sticks from other brands, says Amazon. The pricing is $60, by the way, but you can have it for half that – see below. The new Amazon Fire TV Stick 4K (2026) is powered by a quad-core 1.7GHz processor with 8GB of internal storage. It supports Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth 5.3 and LE. It can decode up to 4K video at 60fps with the H.264, H.265, VP9 and AV1 codecs. It also supports several HDR formats: HDR10, HDR10+ and HLG. Notably, there’s no Dolby Vision –...

title: More images of the Samsung Galaxy Buds On surface, they show off the clip-on design
description: We first heard of the Galaxy Able buds back when the Galaxy Watch9 and Watch Ultra2 leaks were happening. The watches became official, the buds still are not. Since then we’ve learned that these will become Samsung’s first clip-on style buds and will actually be called the Samsung Galaxy Buds On. Here are a few more details, plus a couple of images. Clip-on buds don’t go into your ear canal like regular buds. Instead, they rely on their clip design to stay on your ears – this can be much more comfortable for long periods. The Galaxy Buds On will reportedly use open-ear air conduction....

title: CEO John Ternus wants Apple to be leaner, more experimental and to launch products faster
description: New CEO John Ternus used to be Apple’s SVP of Hardware Engineering, while Tim Cook was a sales guy. We are now starting to see how Ternus’ leadership will be different from Cook’s – Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman reports that Ternus wants to create a “leaner organization” that is focused on engineering. “Leaner” means that there will be some downsizing – apparently, Ternus wants to reduce the number of middle management positions to give engineers a more direct connection to the senior executives. Over the last couple of weeks, Apple has been reportedly reducing the number of engineering program...

title: Honor 700 Pro with its rear screen to be joined by three other interesting phones this year
description: Earlier this month word got out that Honor's upcoming 700 Pro will have a rear screen just like Xiaomi's 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max (and the 17 Pro and 17 Pro Max before that). Today, the prolific leaker who goes by Digital Chat Station on Weibo has shared some more details about it and Honor's other planned releases for the end of this year. The Honor 700 Pro's rear screen is once again 'confirmed' (as much as a rumor can confirm anything), as is its 200MP main camera, which we've heard about before too. Honor will also apparently launch a new X-series phone with a 7" screen and a...

title: AirPods 5 are Apple’s most repairable earbuds ever
description: Wireless earbuds are notoriously difficult to repair and outside of distinct offerings like the Fairphone Fairbuds, there’s virtually no way to repair damaged components. Well, it turns out that Apple has taken a slightly more repair-friendly approach with its latest AirPods 5. The latest teardown from iFixit reveals that Apple is back to using pronged batteries, which are much easier to replace than the glued-in ones on previous iterations. While this is a small win for consumers, the whole process is still very tedious. You’ll need something to clamp the AirPods to and then somehow...

title: The new Samsung SmartTag3 supports iOS, it's also smaller and its battery lasts longer
description: The Samsung SmartTag2 is three years old now and was due for an upgrade. This is the first generation that is cross-platform – it works with both Android and iOS devices. It’s also smaller and lighter, though that came at a cost. New wireless tech allowed Samsung to improve detection range and to extend battery life. The Samsung SmartTag3 can now be used by iPhone owners – this makes it easier if you have Android and iOS devices in your family or if a friend or family member wants to borrow, say, a suitcase with a tag attached. Speaking of attachment, Samsung removed the built-in key...

title: Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra and Galaxy Tab S12+ debut
description: Samsung has unveiled its latest flagship Android tablets, the Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra and Galaxy Tab S12+. The tablets will go on sale in select markets starting October 7. The new Galaxy Tab S12 series tablets share several specifications, although the Ultra model gets a larger display, more RAM and storage, a bigger battery, and a couple of other upgrades over the Plus model. Both the Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra and Galaxy Tab S12+ are powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 9500 chipset and run Android 17-based OneUI 9. It gets a multi-window layout with up to three sections, the latest Galaxy...

title: Oppo F35 series pricing leaked ahead of India launch
description: Ahead of their launch in India next week, the prices of the Oppo F35 and F35 Pro have leaked online. The Oppo F35 series is confirmed to feature a 50MP ultrawide front camera with a 100 degree field-of-view. According to the leak, the Oppo F35 will start at INR 37,999 for the 6GB/128GB variant. The phone is tipped to feature a 6.57 inch AMOLED display, a Dimensity 6360 chipset, and a 50MP primary rear camera paired with a 2MP depth sensor. Meanwhile, the Oppo F35 Pro could be priced between INR 44,000 and INR 50,000 for the base variant with 8GB of RAM and 128GB of...

title: Google Pixel 11a CAD-based renders leak showing more of the same
description: Back in July, purported specs for the upcoming Google Pixel 11a leaked, and today we have some CAD-based renders of the device to look at. The source of these renders also confirms one of the key upgrades that were also mentioned in the aforementioned specs leak, namely that the Pixel 11a will be powered by the Tensor G6 chipset, just like the rest of the Pixel 11 devices. The Pixel 11a is reportedly going to be unveiled next spring, so we're still very far from its release. Anyway, as you can see, the Pixel 11a looks eerily similar to the Pixel 10a, which itself was almost identical...

title: iQOO Pad Ultra is here for gamers with the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6, built-in fan
description: iQOO's gaming-focused small tablet is now official. Meet the iQOO Pad Ultra. It comes with an 8.8-inch AMOLED screen with 2304x1440 resolution (for a 16:10 aspect ratio), a 165Hz refresh rate, and 4,500-nit peak local brightness (peak full-screen brightness is 1,600 nits). Like the iQOO 16, which also launched today, the iQOO Pad Ultra is powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chipset. iQOO has also packed its self-developed Q4 gaming chip into the tablet, as well as its Wi-Fi enhancement chip. The device comes with an active cooling fan too. iQOO Pad Ultra official...

title: Tecno Pova 8 Pro and Pova 8 Pro Tonino Lamborghini unboxing and hands-on
description: Say hello to the Tecno Pova 8 Pro, or should we maybe say the Pova 8 Pros, as we've got two in the office. The regular Pova 8 Pro is joined by the very exclusivePova 8 Pro Tonino Lamborghini special edition. We're going to unbox both, and show you arguably the weirdest thing we've had as part of a smartphone package we've seen yet. One important distinction before we continue: this isn't the car maker Lamborghini but the lifestyle and design brand Tonino Lamborghini. title: vivo X Fold6 European listing reveals its price and specs
description: vivo launched the X Fold6 in China a few months ago, and yesterday a tipster on X claimed to reveal when it will be landing in India as well as other global markets. Today we have the device showing up in listings on the website of an Italian online retailer. These listings show a price of €2,135.90, but this retailer has never actually revealed RRPs before - those will clearly be €2,199.99 or similar. Anyway, the ballpark has now been outed, at least. title: Apple Pay is now available in India
description: Twelve years after first launching its payment service in the US, Apple has finally brought Apple Pay to India, although the service is currently limited to select bank cards. Apple Pay is available to users in India across Apple devices, except Mac, although support for macOS is confirmed to be coming soon. The payment service currently supports Visa and Mastercard credit cards issued by Axis Bank. Users can add their cards to Apple Wallet and use tap-to-pay at thousands of in-store merchants or make online payments. Apple Pay also supports NFC transactions. In an official press...

title: vivo V80 price in India leaks along with full specs
description: vivo is launching the V80 in India on October 6. Ahead of that, today a tipster on X has seemingly revealed the phone's pricing for the Indian market. So without further ado, let's dive right in. The device is said to start at 128GB of storage for INR 63,000 ($657). If you want 256GB, you'll pay INR 70,000 ($730). The top of the line version with 512GB of storage will cost INR 80,000 ($834). According to the same tipster, the V80 has a 6.59-inch LTPS OLED screen with "1.5K" resolution and a 144Hz refresh rate, the Snapdragon 7 Gen 4 SoC at the helm, 8GB of RAM, a 50MP main camera...
